data.name: Harrie
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic words ‘har’ meaning army and ‘ric’ meaning ruler or power. The name Harrie is derived from the old English word ‘hereweard’ meaning army brave or army ruler.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes bravery, leadership, and strength in the face of adversity.
